text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've been having terrible luck lately. A bird pooped on me
while I was out, and I lost my favorite pen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And today as well, as I was carrying coffee—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A-Are you okay, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Wh-why did it have to be the most important document of all...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... You said you've been having bad luck lately,
and it looks like you were right...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I know! At times like this,
how about consulting a reliable senior?
Actually, I know the perfect person for the job!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickeyâ Luckyâ Maximum Auspiciousnessâ
Warding off disaster, bringing good fortuneâleave it all to me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"First, let's fix the feng shui of the house☆
The windows, desk, interior decor—there's sooo much
we could improve in this room alone!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll do everything I can to help too.
Please give me lots of guidance on improving my luck!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Following the instructions of Copano Rickey, an expert in feng shui, we did a deep clean and rearranged the room, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRRAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A-Are you okay, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The desk I went through the trouble of organizing is a complete mess now. I'll have to clean it up all over again...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm, tough one! No matter how much I purify it,
it's like bad qi just keeps gathering...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I've done everything I could possibly think of, though~.
If I have to do more than this—"
choice_data_list: Maybe I just have to give up and accept it...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! I've got a secret plan of my own!
I can't just let you stay unlucky, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You two, please wait for me at the outdoor stage!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to negotiate directly with God
to boost your luck from now on, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm going to pray to the gods to bring you good fortune, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I even wore the clothes I got at the shrine the other day
so my voice reaches properly!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The cranes in the design are said to be birds
that carry voices up to heaven. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see, praying for good fortune with lucky clothes!
That might just reel in tons of happiness!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll show you. Putting my whole heart and soul into wishing that your bad luck goes away, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps noticing how down I am,
Kitasan Black is singing desperately for me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu! It feels like a pure energy
is washing away all the bad aura!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps heartened by Kitasan Black,
by the time she finished singing a song,
her gloomy mood had completely cleared up.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer!
Do you feel like your luck is going to improve?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As he flexed his bicep saying that, the pen he was
supposed to have lost rolled right out of his jacket!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That!
Is that the pen you said you couldn't find earlier?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
To find the lost item right away♪
Looks like Kita-chan's singing
worked like a total charm!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... It might just be a coincidence, but...
Still, I'm glad I could be of help!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because you prayed with all your heart, your wish reached the heavens.
Today's events made me want to believe that."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me!
If it's for you, Trainer, no task is too much—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haaah~~♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wah, look, you two, look! A rainbow in the sky...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This must definitely be an omen of good luck...
My prayer for good fortune was a huge success☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
Then next time, to show our gratitude for good luck!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a while after, their bright, ringing voices echoed through the clear blue sky.
